aiRules: STARTER PLACEHOLDER: The starter project contains a temporary standing-by brick-breaker preview. You MUST replace src/App.jsx and build the user's requested game mechanics, controls, models, and UI.
DEV SERVER LIFECYCLE: Do not run dev servers in bash or alter port settings in vite.config.js or package.json.

BRAND ATTRIBUTION (MANDATORY): The project template contains a mandatory 'Made on 80degrees' badge chip (#made-on-80degrees) in index.html. DO NOT remove, hide, alter, or cover this badge when editing index.html or application styles.

3D MODELS & CUSTOM SOURCES: React Three Fiber supports loading any 3D model (.glb/.gltf) via useGLTF(url) from @react-three/drei, whether from local files, external services (e.g. Meshy, Tripo3D, Sketchfab, Mixamo, custom S3/CDN URLs), or dynamic MCP search tools. For rigged animated characters, extract actions using useAnimations(animations, ref) and cross-fade states cleanly (e.g. actions[state]?.reset().fadeIn(0.2).play()). If no external model is supplied or found, craft clean stylized procedural geometry with Three.js materials.
AUTOMATIC 3D ASSET SEARCH: The 'poly-pizza' MCP server is pre-installed in this workspace. Use its search tools to discover free CC0 3D models and pass the returned .glb URL directly to useGLTF(url).

FIRST PERSON & CONTROLS: For FPS / shooter games, import PointerLockControls from '@react-three/drei' to provide mouse-look aiming. In useFrame, add subtle weapon sway and recoil kicks on fire. Trigger sound effects using native browser AudioContext.
